rows.remaining: This row proves the pinned DXC target progression and PSO linking for the synthetic corpus; it does not claim exhaustive opcode or stage coverage.
The exact semantic readback set covers arithmetic, buffers, barriers, wave/quad operations, SM6.7 vector/int64 arithmetic, SM6.8 wide arithmetic, and SM6.9 float16 conversion.
Unsupported semantics are rejected instead of being promoted through placeholder MSL; implementation breadth remains tracked by the open exhaustive row.
Append/consume UAV counters remain explicitly unsupported and require a dedicated provider and readback matrix.
Positive and negative evidence is still incomplete for the full stable SM5.x-DXBC through SM6.9-DXIL opcode/intrinsic, graphics-stage, texture-dimension, counter, cache, and compiler-session matrix.
